options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: More_Knowledge
options.doc:
Adds all the Items you receive from a Knowledge Stations into the pool of items and as extra checks.
These Items which are labeled as 'Structures' and 'Consumables' ingame.
options.doc_fr:
Ajoute tous les items que vous recevez d'un Knowledge Stations dans le pool des items et comme vérifications supplémentaires.
Ces items qui sont étiquetés comme 'Structures' et 'Consommables' ingame.

options.name: Boss_Bonus
options.doc: Bosses that fewer than 3 locations will receive additional locations.
options.doc_fr: Boss que moins de 3 emplacements recevront des emplacements supplémentaires.

options.name: JournalSanity
options.doc:
Adds all journals to the location pool, progression granted by journals will not be added to the item pool.
This will primarily add filler.
options.doc_fr:
Ajoute toutes les revues au pool d'emplacement, la progression accordée par les revues ne sera pas ajoutée au pool d'articles.
Ceci ajoutera principalement le remplissage.
